name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_on_raw_keyboard_char
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::OnRawKeyboardChar optionally filters raw key input through the numeric accepted-key set before dispatching to the embedded HudUiTextInput.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiNumericTextInput source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b4b50 validates checking sliderBorder.rawKeyFilterEnabled, calling strchr over the numeric accepted-key string when filtering is enabled, dispatching accepted keys to HudUiTextInput::DispatchKeyAction(&textInput, key), and returning 0.

Native smoke zhud_numeric_text_input_base_constructor_smoke verifies unfiltered raw key dispatch inserts '5', filtered raw key dispatch rejects 'x', and filtered accepted raw key dispatch inserts another '5'.
